current_status.from: Active/extended as of 2026-09-23. Two days before the original term's 2026-09-22 expiration, the Board adopted Resolution No. 1612 at its August 24, 2026 meeting, extending the data center zoning moratorium for an additional 12 months (to approximately 2027-09-22, computed from the original expiry since the resolution text says 'extend' rather than restate a new term; the official minutes do not themselves state the new numeric end date). Local reporting (McCook Gazette, McCook News Now) independently confirms the extension. No repeal, rescission, or permanent replacement ordinance was found.
